name: Cinematic
oneliner: Sweeping whooshes, a riser into a deep hit, and long tails that breathe.
description: Bigger, slower sound for tours and reveals. Each cut swells; the hook lands with weight.
prompt: Sound pass, preset cinematic. Set EDL to the EDL the draft was rendered from ($W/edl.story.json after a story pass, else $W/edl.json). Run it on the finished picture (after captions, before QA): python3 scripts/rr.py run -- python3 engines/sound.py "$W/captioned.mp4" --out "$W/sound.mp4" --edl "$EDL" --captions "$W/draft.words.json" --preset cinematic. Voice polish + room-tone bed as in S1, plus: a riser that crests at the end of the hook with an impact-bass hit there; a cinematic whoosh on each internal cut with its swell peaking on the cut (-14 dB under the voice); sound tails kept twice as long and a light echo on the effects bus so they decay naturally. No caption pops. Ends at -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP, video stream copied. Best with few cuts (one every 3 s or more). Do NOT use on a fast jump-cut talking head, and do NOT run a second S card.
